consumer: The frontend tile renderer, which asks per nearby tile 'is this tile currently visible to the player, or only remembered?' to decide whether to draw it dimmed.
scope: a map region: the nearby tiles around the avatar within ctx.radius
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (seen) writes ctx.m.pl_sees(p, ctx.radius) per tile, the current-visibility flag the renderer dims/brightens by.
divergence: A tile the avatar saw earlier but is now blocked from (e.g. behind a freshly-closed door): pl_sees returns false so it must draw dimmed/remembered; a wrong answer rendering it full-bright (treated as visible) or blank (treated as never-seen) is exposed.
